name: Koality Layout Builder Layouts
description: Ships a set of base multi-column layouts and options as a starting point for Layout Builder.
project_description:
Create some base layouts and options that is a good jumping off point for your Layout Builder Needs

 Features 

 
 A set of configurable layouts, 1, 2, 3, and 4 columns. 
 Options to set the Width, Spacing between columns, above and below the layout 
 Option to have different background colors per column or the layout as a whole.
